metadata.description: Tools AI coding agents use to secure your stack: code with xgrep, posture and policy with cnspec

plugins.name: understand-code
plugins.description: Understand an unfamiliar codebase before you change it — map structure, find definitions/callers, trace call chains, and assess a change's blast radius with xgrep's AST code graph

plugins.name: secure-coding
plugins.description: Write it safely — avoid vulnerable patterns across 7 languages, aligned to OWASP Top 10:2025 and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM & GenAI 2025

plugins.name: secure-pipeline
plugins.description: Verify and enforce security before code ships — scan code (SAST/SCA/secrets) with xgrep and IaC/config with cnspec, then triage and fix, mapped to OWASP Top 10:2025 and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM & GenAI 2025

plugins.name: triage-findings
plugins.description: Decide whether a security finding is real — classify xgrep scan results as true or false positives by tracing dataflow and call chains with the code graph

plugins.name: fix-findings
plugins.description: Fix xgrep security findings and prove each fix holds — one finding or a whole set (or the triage-confirmed true positives) — through the verify/apply harness

plugins.name: author-detections
plugins.description: Catch a pattern nothing else catches — author a custom, tested xgrep/Semgrep detection rule (including taint-mode dataflow), or port a rule to new languages

plugins.name: secure-os
plugins.description: Audit and harden operating systems and network devices — scan a Linux/macOS/Windows host, container image, or network device against CIS/vendor benchmarks with cnspec

plugins.name: secure-cloud
plugins.description: Audit cloud account security posture — scan AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes against CIS foundations and Mondoo cloud policies with cnspec

plugins.name: secure-saas
plugins.description: Audit SaaS and identity-provider security posture — scan GitHub, GitLab, Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Atlassian, and Snowflake with cnspec

plugins.name: secure-ai-services
plugins.description: Secure AI services and AI tooling — scan OpenAI, Anthropic, vLLM, Databricks AI, and vector stores with cnspec, and govern approved AI agents/IDE-extensions/MCP servers, mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10
